how_you_tell: Has no AI they are allowed to use for work yet
lever: Access, and a reason to use AI in the first week

how_you_tell: Is allowed to use AI for work, but has not tried it yet
lever: A first task done side by side with someone who already uses AI

how_you_tell: Tried AI once or twice, then stopped
lever: A second task that fits their actual week

how_you_tell: Is still working out what AI is allowed for, or has just read the rules
lever: A worked example from their own role

how_you_tell: Uses AI only in the weeks a reminder goes out
lever: One recurring task tied to a day of the week

how_you_tell: Has used AI once on real work that went to someone else
lever: Make that recurring task part of their routine

how_you_tell: Uses AI every week on one task, for a month or more
lever: A second task, and a place to share what works

how_you_tell: Uses AI on several tasks and shares what works
lever: Ask them to show their team

how_you_tell: AI is part of how they work every week, and colleagues come to them with questions
lever: Give them a prompt to look after in the library, and point new starters their way
